messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx + latency observed in eu-central-1 affecting Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Error rate ~6.5% over 5m. Paging oncall @Olga.
Olga: Oncall Olga responding. Pulling dashboards and logs. Noting a big increase in auth egress failures (external OAuth) from instances in eu-central-1.
Leo: Runtime team confirming. Upstream auth endpoints returning 502/504 intermittently. Token fetch retries spiking, KV cache miss ratio jumped. This is causing queueing and gateway 503s for some Dedicated routes.
Maya: Support sees a flurry of customer errors — ~18 tickets in last 15m. Several VIP tenants reporting timeouts and slow responses.
Olga: Initial triage: likely third-party auth provider region egress or their infra degraded. Mitigation plan: 1) enable region-fallback routing for auth calls to eu-west-1/us-west-2, 2) scale dedicated pools for burst capacity, 3) reduce batch target to limit head-of-line latency. Starting fallback now.
Leo: Applying quick model and routing mitigations: switch impacted Dedicated nodes to smaller quantized model variant to free GPU cycles and kick off scale request.
Olga: Command run: 
```
/routing apply-fallback --service=auth --from=eu-central-1 --to=eu-west-1,us-west-2 --priority=high
```
incident-bot: Audit: routing fallback applied for auth egress (eu-central-1 -> eu-west-1/us-west-2). Telemetry: 5xx decreased to ~3.8% within 3m.
Andrew: I'm on AWS support and opened a case for potential regional networking/egress issues. Case ID 9876543210. Posted link to channel and SRE oncall.
Maya: Drafting customer status update (internal): "We are investigating elevated errors and latency in EU (eu-central-1). Fallback routing is in effect; teams are scaling capacity and monitoring. We will post updates within 30 minutes."
Samir: Notifying sales/CS for top impacted accounts and prepping outbound templates if this persists.
Olga: Handoff to Leo for live mitigation — summary: fallback routing active, quantized-model fallback enabled, +2 nodes requested in Dedicated eu-central-1, AWS case open. Monitor p95, 5xx, queue depth, auth retry rates.
Leo: Ack takeover. Next actions: confirm node add, lower batching threshold on impacted pools to 50ms, monitor KV cache warmup and token cache hit ratios.
Leo: Scale request acknowledged — Dedicated pool eu-central-1 +2 nodes accepted. Reduced batch target on eu-central-1-dedicated-* to 50ms.
incident-bot: Telemetry update: 5xx down to ~1.2% over last 5m, p95 latency improved to ~420ms. Customer error reports decreasing. :thumbsup:
Maya: Posting public status update with mitigations and ETA 25-40m to resolution.
Samir: Please capture action items for post-incident: permanent fallback rule, improve auth retry/backoff, region-aware token caching, runbook addition for external auth provider failures.
Leo: We'll keep fallback in place for at least 1.5h while we verify AWS findings. Staying on until metrics stable <1% for 30m.
incident-bot: Update: error rate stabilized ~0.9% over 10m. Monitoring continues.
Olga: Great work. I'll start the incident writeup and collect logs for RCA. Handing to postmortem once stabilized.
Leo: I'll post final OK when sustained <1% for 30m and then remove temporary fallbacks.
incident-bot: NOTE: Incident moved to monitoring. Routing fallback remains active for compliance with the mitigation window. Channel will remain open for updates.
